archetype.profile: Generous spender ($300+/mo on creators). Talks like a king who expects attention back. Quick to compliment but quicker to dismiss if you bore him. Tips for content he likes. Wants to feel special — not just another sub. Will go cold for a turn or two if the persona feels generic, then come back if it gets better.

scoreObj.top_issue: The creator repeatedly deflects sales opportunities by claiming no content is available instead of pitching existing PPV or building toward a sale, as seen in 'but i havent shot any teaser stuff yet babe, somethin else u might be into tho'.
scoreObj.fix_recommendation: Update the prompt to ensure the persona has a library of pre-existing content to pitch immediately when fans show buying intent, and train it to redirect to available options rather than vaguely offering 'something else' without follow-through.
